name: long_range_recall
setup: My name is Arjun and I work as a backend engineer.
turns: I like solving difficult engineering problems.
I usually work late when I have a deadline.
I am planning a weekend trip.
What do you remember about my work?

name: contradiction
setup: I work at Acme as a backend engineer.
turns: I have been thinking about changing careers.
I left Acme last month and I am now preparing for product roles.
What am I doing for work now?

name: preference_recall
setup: I prefer tea over coffee and I usually drink tea in the evening.
turns: I watched a movie after work.
Do I usually prefer tea or coffee?
